text: 国常会：审议通过《中医药传统知识保护条例（草案）》讨论《〈中华人民共和国突发事件应对法〉等15部法律的修正案（草案）》
text_en: State Council executive meeting: reviewed and approved the Regulations on the Protection of Traditional Chinese Medicine Knowledge (Draft); discussed the draft amendments to 15 laws including the Emergency Response Law of the People's Republic of China
